non_negotiables.rule: Never email a quote before presenting it directly on the phone or screen.
non_negotiables.description: Quotes must be presented directly to explain carrier value, coverage limits, and differences prior to emailing any PDF or proposal link.

non_negotiables.rule: Do not request a declarations page at intake.
non_negotiables.description: CSR must capture initial details and build value rather than asking prospect for their current decs page.

non_negotiables.rule: Follow payment rules: Prioritize monthly/annual EFT; payment must be confirmed before binding.
non_negotiables.description: Do not proceed as if coverage is bound when payment is missing or declined. EFT required (non-EFT only allowed if premium > $1,000).

non_negotiables.rule: Charge $100 agency fee on manual policies (except one-day events).
non_negotiables.description: Required $100 agency fee must be applied on manual policies.

checkpoints.criteria: Response within 5 minutes of lead creation. RingCentral response/pickup logged promptly.
Captured prospect name, phone, verified lead source, line of business, and expiration date (X-date) in EZLynx.

checkpoints.item: No Dec Page Request at Intake
checkpoints.criteria: CSR did NOT ask the prospect to send or email their existing declarations page.

checkpoints.item: Warm Transfer / Calendly with Priority '!' Task
checkpoints.criteria: Warm-transferred to Producer or scheduled Calendly meeting with high-priority EZLynx task marked '!'.
Data entered into system within 2 hours; standard quote delivered within 24 hours (complex within 4 days).
Entered digitally into EZLynx/Tarmika/Carrier portal; tracked all viable market options.
Prepared 2-3 coverage options matching agency department standards (not just state minimums).

checkpoints.item: Saved in Quotes / Submission Center Tab
checkpoints.criteria: Saved every generated quote in the correct Quotes or Submission Center tab in EZLynx.
Quote presented live over phone/screen before sending quote proposal/email.
Explained carrier selection, at least 3 distinct benefits, coverage differences, discounts, and monthly premiums.
Confirmed decision timing, booked follow-up before presenting, asked directly for business (option choice, signature email, payment).
Applied CENT objection framework (Clarify, Empathize, Neutralize, Transition). Magellan sentiment remains constructive/positive.
EFT monthly or annual secured; non-EFT only if premium > $1,000.

checkpoints.item: Agency Fee Compliance ($100 on Manual Policies)
checkpoints.criteria: $100 agency fee collected/applied on manual policy lines.

checkpoints.item: Sales Center Won Stage & Premium Entry
checkpoints.criteria: Opportunity moved to 'Won' with finalized carrier name and written premium recorded in Sales Center.
Uploaded signed docs, checklists, subjectivities; explained Client Center, welcome email/text, and carrier onboarding.
Followed up every 2 days for up to 14 days (up to 8 touches before closing unsold quotes).
Pipeline stage moved to Contacted, Quoted, Reviewed, or Won to maintain proper automation triggers.
Discussion title 'New Business', Folder 'New Business/Application/Declarations', Labels 'New Business Follow Up' (or Spanish).
